summary: A 1934 state stairway tower south of Highway 2 in Fond du Lac State Forest; no longer standing, and the state list calls the site an ARMER site.

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: the 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey note gives about 70 ft (record 21.3 m, kept) and the state list gives 100 ft; the story says so. The site today is known only through the ARMER label; no source found on access, staffing or fires. The state list is dated September 2023. Record coordinates sit about 25 m from the list's point; not changed.
